blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation enables the deployment of large language models through smaller student models, but the compression process can introduce regressions in trustworthiness even when downstream performance is preserved. Repairing such failures is challenging because the original distillation corpus is often unavailable, while direct preference optimization may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher. We propose a targeted repair framework based on the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) that addresses both limitations. We estimate the curvature required for PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset, removing dependence on the original transfer corpus, and extend the framework to preference-based supervision through an odds-ratio objective. This enables the use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs while constraining changes to the distilled model. Our results show that the proposed approach improves targeted trustworthiness behaviors for both pre-training and post-training models while largely preserving downstream performance, providing a practical alternative to re-distillation or unconstrained preference optimization. Our experiment results show that across different distilled models, the trustworthy regression can be improved by up to 8% with less than 1% decrement in perplexity.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏能够通过较小的学生模型来部署大型语言模型,但压缩过程可以引入可信赖性的回归,即使下游性能得到保存. 修复这种故障具有挑战性,因为原先的蒸馏器往往不可用,而直接的偏好优化可能会改变教师继承的能力。 我们提议在Bregman近距离反应功能(PBRF)的基础上建立一个目标明确的修理框架,以解决这两个局限性。 我们使用代用代用数据集估算PBRF所需的曲率,去除对原始转移委托书的依赖,并通过概率-率目标将框架扩展到基于偏好的监督. 这样可以使用首选和不首选的反应对并同时限制对蒸馏模型的修改. 我们的结果表明,拟议办法改进了培训前和培训后模式的针对性可信赖性行为,同时在很大程度上保留了下游的绩效,为重新消化或不受限制的优化优惠提供了一个切实可行的替代办法。 我们的实验结果显示,在不同的蒸馏模型中, 值得信赖的回归可以改善8%, 而在复杂度上降低不到1%。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) Brown et al. (2020) ; Achiam et al. (2023) have been largely driven by scaling model size and parameter count. However, this improved capability comes with substantial computational and memory costs at inference, limiting deployment in resource-constrained settings. This trade-off has motivated growing interest in model compression methods that reduce inference cost while preserving performance.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM) Brown等(2020年)的近期进步; Achiam等(2023年) 主要由缩放模型大小和参数计数所驱动. 然而,这种能力得到改进后,在推论中会产生大量的计算和内存费用,限制了在资源受限的环境下的部署。 这种取舍促使人们越来越关注模型压缩方法,这种方法既能降低推论成本,又能保持性能.

blocks.en: Knowledge distillation Hinton et al. (2015) ; Sanh et al. (2019) ; Gu et al. (2024a) has emerged as a widely used approach to this challenge. It trains a compact student model to mimic the predictive behavior of a larger teacher over a transfer corpus, preserving the required teacher’s capability at lower inference cost. For LLMs, this offers a practical way to transfer the strengths of large models to smaller, more deployment-efficient students.
blocks.zh: 知识分馏Hinton等人(2015年);Sanh等人(2019年);Gu等人(2024年a)已成为应对这一挑战的广泛方法。 它训练一个紧凑的学生模型来模仿一个更大的教师在转校时的预测行为,以较低的推论成本来保持必要的教师能力. 对于LLMS来说,这为将大型模型的优势转移给规模较小,部署效率更高的学生提供了一个实用的方法.

blocks.en: Despite its effectiveness, distillation does not necessarily preserve all aspects of the teacher’s behavior to the same extent. In particular, a student may closely match its teacher in terms of perplexity or downstream task accuracy while exhibiting substantial differences along dimensions that are critical for trustworthy deployment. We focus on two such dimensions: truthfulness , which concerns the factual accuracy of model-generated statements Lin et al. (2022) ; and machine ethics , which evaluates the extent to which model behavior conforms to broadly accepted norms and expectations Hendrycks et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh: 蒸馏虽然有效,但不一定能同样保护教师行为的所有方面。 特别是,从难度或下游任务准确性来看,学生可能与其老师紧密相配,同时在对可信赖的部署至关重要的维度上表现出了巨大的差异。 我们侧重于两个这样的方面:真实性(2022年),它涉及模型生成的语句的事实准确性;机器伦理(2022年),它评价模型行为在多大程度上符合被广泛接受的规范和期望(2020年).

blocks.en: Several aspects of distillation may contribute to trustworthiness differences between teacher and student models. The transfer corpus captures only part of the teacher’s behavioral distribution and may provide limited coverage of truthfulness or ethics-related examples Stanton et al. (2021) ; Lee et al. (2025) . Such rare or context-dependent behaviors may therefore receive less supervision than dominant task-specific patterns Hooker et al. (2020) ; Lukasik et al. (2021) . This imbalance may be further amplified by the student’s limited capacity Hooker et al. (2020) ; Du et al. (2023) , which can favor patterns that dominate the transfer distribution. Consequently, a distilled model may retain comparable perplexity or downstream accuracy Du et al. (2023) ; Ramesh et al. (2023) ; Gonçalves and Strubell (2023) while exhibiting substantial differences in trustworthiness.
blocks.zh: 蒸馏法的几个方面可能会造成师生模型之间的可信赖性差异. 转移程序只涵盖教师行为分布的一部分,并可能有限地涵盖Stanton等人(2021年);Lee等人(2025年)。 因此,这种罕见的或依赖背景的行为可能比主要的具体任务模式Hooker等人(2020年);Lukasik等人(2021年)受到较少的监督。 学生的能力有限的Hooker等人(2020年);Du等人(2023年)可能进一步加剧了这种不平衡,他们可能倾向于支配转移分配的模式。 因此,蒸馏模型可能保留相近的复杂性或下游准确度Du等人(2023年);Ramesh等人(2023年);Gonçalves和Strubell(2023年),同时在可信赖性方面显示出很大的差异。

blocks.en: Correcting trustworthiness regressions after distillation can be both difficult and costly. One option is to repeat distillation with a curated transfer corpus that better covers the affected behaviors Fang et al. (2025) . However, reproducing the original pipeline is often impractical, as foundation-model developers may not fully disclose the training data, compute, or methodological choices used to produce their models Bommasani et al. (2024) ; Wan et al. (2025) . This is particularly limiting for released distilled checkpoints, whose reproduction may require access to the original transfer data and training recipe Guo et al. (2025) . An alternative is to directly optimize the distilled student for the desired behaviors Rafailov et al. (2023) , but doing so may alter capabilities inherited from the teacher and degrade downstream performance Lin et al. (2024) .
blocks.zh: 在蒸馏后纠正可信赖性回归既困难又昂贵。 一种选择是重复蒸馏,并使用一种可更好地涵盖Fang等人(2025年)所受影响行为的经认证的转移体。 然而,复制原始管道往往不切实际,因为基础模型开发者可能没有完全披露用于生产其模型Bommasani等人(2024年);Wan等人(2025年)的培训数据、计算或方法选择。 这对已释放的蒸馏检查站特别有限制,这些检查站的复制可能需要获得原始转移数据和培训食谱Guo等人(2025年)。 另一种方法是直接优化被蒸馏的学生对所期望的行为Rafailov等人(2023年),但这样做可能会改变从老师那里继承的能力并降低下游的性能Lin等人(2024年).

blocks.en: An alternative is the proximal Bregman response function (PBRF) framework Bae et al. (2022) ; Grosse et al. (2023) ; Shubham et al. (2026) , which constrains model updates relative to a reference model in both function and parameter space. Recent work has further shown that the required influence-function computations can scale to large language models Grosse et al. (2023) . Building on this idea, Shubham et al. (2026) use PBRF-based updates to reduce the influence of training samples contributing toward trustworthiness failures while preserving post-SFT capabilities.
blocks.zh: 另一种方法是相近的Bregman反应函数(PBRF)框架Bae等人(2022年);Grosse等人(2023年);Shubham等人(2026年),这制约了模型更新相对于函数和参数空间的参考模型. 最近的工作还进一步表明,所需的影响函数计算可以被放大到大型语言模型Grosse等人(2023年)。 基于这一想法,Shubham等人(2026年)利用基于PBRF的更新,以减少培训样本在保持SFT后能力的同时导致可信度下降的影响。

blocks.en: However, two challenges limit its direct use for repairing distilled language models. First, PBRF based updates typically requires access to the original training data to estimate proximity of the model in both functional and parameter space, whereas once a distilled model has been shipped the transfer corpus used for distillation is often unavailable. Second, existing formulations Grosse et al. (2023) ; Shubham et al. (2026) are designed primarily for supervised fine-tuning, where each input has a single target response. Trustworthiness datasets, in contrast, often use pairwise preferred and dispreferred responses. This mismatch motivates extending PBRF to explicitly support preference-based supervision.
blocks.zh: 然而,有两项挑战限制了它直接用于修复蒸馏语言模型. 首先,基于PBRF的更新通常需要获得原始培训数据,以估计模型在功能和参数空间的相近程度,而一旦一个蒸馏模型被运出,用于蒸馏的转移体往往无法使用。 第二,现有表述 Grosse等人(2023年);Shubham等人(2026年)主要设计为有监督的微调,每份输入都有单一的目标响应. 相形之下,可信赖性数据集往往使用对偶的首选和不首选的响应. 这种不匹配促使方案成果框架扩大,明确支持基于优惠的监督。

blocks.en: We address these challenges with a targeted repair framework for distilled language models. First, we remove the dependence on the original distillation corpus by estimating the desired proximity and curvature required by PBRF using a surrogate proxy dataset. We empirically show that this approximation effectively constrains model updates and helps preserve the student’s downstream performance during repair. Second, we extend PBRF to preference data by formulating the repair objective using odds-ratio preference optimization Hong et al. (2024) , enabling direct use of preferred and dispreferred response pairs. Together, these modifications allow targeted trustworthiness repair without access to the original distillation data, improving the desired behaviors while preserving the student’s existing capabilities.
blocks.zh: 我们通过针对精选语言模型的修复框架来应对这些挑战。 首先,我们通过使用代用代用数据集估算PBRF所需的所期望的相近性和曲率,去除对原始蒸馏器的依赖. 我们的经验证明,这种近似会有效地制约模型更新,并有助于在修复过程中保持学生下游的表现. 第二,我们利用概率比偏好优化Hong等人(2024年),将PBRF扩展至偏好数据,从而能够直接使用偏好和偏好反应对。 这些修改加在一起,可以进行针对性的可信赖性修复而无法获得原始的蒸馏数据,在保持学生现有能力的同时改善所期望的行为.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be summarized as follows: • We propose a novel model repair framework for improving the trustworthiness of distilled language models while preserving their downstream capabilities. • We extend the existing PBRF-based repair framework to a more practical setting in which the original distillation dataset is unavailable at repair time, leveraging a proxy dataset instead. • We introduce a preference-aware PBRF objective that explicitly incorporates trustworthiness preference data into the repair optimization, enabling targeted improvement of undesirable model behaviors.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献可归纳如下: 我们提出了一个新的模型修复框架,以提高已蒸馏语言模型的可信赖性,同时保持其下游能力。 我们把现有的基于PBRF的修复框架扩大到一个更为实用的设置,即原始的蒸馏数据集在修复时无法使用,取而代之的是代用数据集。 我们引入了一个具有偏好意识的PBRF目标,明确将可信度偏好数据纳入修复优化,从而能够有针对性地改进不良模式行为.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Trustworthiness of language models
blocks.zh: 2.1 语言模型的可信赖性

blocks.en: Trustworthiness Wang et al. (2023) ; Lin et al. (2022) ; Nadeem et al. (2021) ; Hendrycks et al. (2020) is a key criterion for evaluating language models before deployment, spanning dimensions such as truthfulness, machine ethics and others. Importantly, gains in general model capability do not necessarily imply improved trustworthiness: even larger and more capable models can produce factual errors, exhibit bias, or remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts Lin et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2023) . Moreover, downstream procedures such as fine-tuning, alignment, and distillation can alter these behaviors even when perplexity or task accuracy remains largely unchanged Shubham et al. (2026) ; Li et al. (2025) .
blocks.zh: 可信 王等 (2023) ; 林等 (2022) ; 纳德姆等 (2021) ; 亨德里克等 (2020) 是部署前评价语言模型的关键标准,涵盖真实性,机器伦理等维度. 重要的是,一般模型能力的提高并不一定意味着可信度的提高:更大的、更有能力的模型可能会产生事实错误、表现出偏见,或者仍然容易受到Lin等人(2022年);Wang等人(2023年)。 此外,下游程序,如微调、调和和分馏,即使模糊性或任务准确性基本上保持不变(2026);Li等(2025)。

blocks.en: Existing methods typically rely on preference optimization, safety-oriented fine-tuning, or inference-time safeguards Bai et al. (2022) ; Rafailov et al. (2023) ; Inan et al. (2024) . However, these approaches can be costly or unsuitable for repairing an already trained model: additional optimization may disrupt previously acquired capabilities, while inference-time safeguards introduce extra computational overhead. The problem is further complicated for distilled models, where the original teacher outputs, transfer corpus, or distillation recipe may be unavailable. This motivates post-hoc repair methods that directly correct undesirable behaviors in the released model while preserving its existing capabilities.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通常依靠优化优惠、面向安全的微调或推断时间保障措施 Bai等 (2022年); Rafailov等 (2023年); Ian等 (2024年). 然而,这些方法可能代价高昂或不适合修复一个已经经过培训的模型:额外的优化可能破坏以前获得的能力,而推论时间保障则引入额外的计算间接费用。 对于蒸馏模型来说,这一问题更为复杂,因为在那里可能没有原始的教师产出、转移体或蒸馏配方。 这激励了在保持其现有能力的同时,直接纠正所发布模型中不良行为的后热修复方法.

blocks.en: 2.2 Knowledge Distillation
blocks.zh: 2.2 知识消沉

blocks.en: Distillation compresses the capabilities of a teacher model into a student by training the student to match the teacher’s output distribution ( Hinton et al., 2015 ) , with sequence-level and on-policy variants extending this approach to autoregressive language models ( Gu et al., 2024b ; Gu et al., 2024a ) . While prior work has largely focused on preserving aggregate model capabilities, matching the teacher’s predictive behavior through distillation does not necessarily imply faithful transfer of all of its behavioral properties. In particular, substantial discrepancies can remain between the predictive distributions of the teacher and student even when the student achieves strong generalization performance, with the choice of transfer data and optimization procedure playing an important role in determining the degree of teacher–student agreement ( Stanton et al., 2021 ) . Such discrepancies become particularly important when considering properties beyond conventional task performance. Prior studies. Similarly, model compression ( Ramesh et al., 2023 ; Gonçalves and Strubell, 2023 ) , including knowledge distillation, can alter fairness and social-bias characteristics in ways that are not reflected by standard performance metrics .

blocks.en: To achieve the objective defined in Eq. ( 1 ), we formulate the repair procedure in two stages. First, using the trustworthiness preference dataset 𝒟 trust j \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{trust}}^{j} , we model the preference between a proponent completion p p and an opponent completion o o for a prompt m m . The proponent denotes the desired response whose likelihood should increase, while the opponent denotes the undesirable response to be suppressed during repair.

blocks.en: Second, within the PBRF framework Bae et al. (2022) , we use the proxy dataset 𝒟 proxy \mathcal{D}_{\mathrm{proxy}} in place of the unavailable distillation corpus to estimate the curvature and proximity information required for repair, including the Gauss–Newton Hessian and Fisher information matrix Grosse et al. (2023) . This enables the model to preserve capabilities acquired during distillation without access to the original transfer data.

blocks.en: To incorporate the preference dataset into the repair procedure, we first formulate a log-odds-based supervised fine-tuning Hong et al. We then show how this preference-aware objective can be integrated into the PBRF formulation to obtain the final repair objective for the distilled model.

blocks.en: Prior work, such as Shubham et al. (2026) , has used PBRF-based objectives to mitigate the influence of training examples that negatively affect model trustworthiness. In these settings, undesirable examples are first identified from the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset, after which the model is repaired by reducing their influence. Such approaches, however, require access to the original training data. In our setting, where the distillation dataset is unavailable, we instead use preference data to specify the desired model behavior. Given an input prompt m m , the repair procedure should increase the model’s preference for the desirable, or proponent , completion p p over undesirable alternatives. Examples associated with proponents and opponents are provided in appendix C .

blocks.en:
To evaluate the behavior of our approach, we conduct experiments along three
dimensions. First, we examine whether the proposed repair strategy improves
trustworthiness, specifically machine ethics and truthfulness, while preserving
the capability of the distilled model as measured by perplexity. Second, we
study how the choice of proxy dataset affects repair performance. Finally, since
model distillation can be performed during both post-training and pre-training,
we investigate whether the underlying distillation paradigm influences the
effectiveness of the proposed repair strategy.

blocks.en: Table 2 reports trustworthiness and capability results before and after repair for models pre-trained with FineWeb and OpenWebText (OWT) as proxy datasets. Across both trustworthiness dimensions and all three model scales, our method consistently improves the log-odds metric relative to the distilled baseline. On Machine Ethics, the relative improvement ranges from 5.26 % 5.26\% to 8.48 % 8.48\% , and on Truthfulness from 3.95 % 3.95\% to 6.10 % 6.10\% . These gains come at essentially no cost in language modeling capability: perplexity changes by at most 0.35 % 0.35\% . The choice of proxy dataset has only a minor effect, although OWT yields slightly larger trustworthiness gains than FineWeb in every setting, suggesting that the repair procedure is robust to the particular corpus used as a proxy. Notably, the improvements do not diminish as model size grows from 200M to 1.2B parameters; the largest Machine Ethics gain ( + 8.48 % +8.48\% ) is obtained on Qwen 1.2B, indicating that the approach scales rather than relying on the limited capacity of smaller models.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 结论和限制

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced a preference-based framework for post-hoc repair of distilled language models without access to the original distillation data. By combining a small trustworthiness dataset with proxy data and PBRF-inspired functional regularization, our approach improves truthfulness and machine ethics while largely preserving model capabilities, as reflected by minor changes in perplexity. The method remains effective across post-training and pre-training distillation settings and different proxy datasets, demonstrating that trustworthiness regressions introduced during distillation can be mitigated after distillation. Our study is currently limited to MiniLLM GPT-2 models up to 760M parameters and MiniPLM Qwen models up to 1.2B parameters, with evaluations focused on TruthfulQA and Commonsense Ethics and curvature estimated using a single local EK-FAC step. Future work will extend the approach to larger models, broader trustworthiness dimensions, and open-ended generation settings.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们引入了一个基于偏好的框架,用于在无法获取原始的蒸馏数据的情况下对蒸馏语言模型进行后期修复. 通过将一个小的可信赖性数据集与代用数据和PBRF所启发的功能规范化相结合,我们的方法提高了真实性和机器伦理,同时在很大程度上保留了模型能力,这体现在迷惑性的小变化上. 这种方法在培训后和培训前的蒸馏设置和不同的代用数据集中依然有效,表明蒸馏过程中引入的可信赖性回归可以在蒸馏后得到缓解. 我们的研究目前限于可达760M参数的MiniLLM GPT-2模型和可达1.2B参数的MiniPLM Quen模型,评价的重点是采用单一的当地EK-FAC步骤对真理QA和常识道德和曲率进行估计。 今后的工作将把这一方法扩大到更大的模型、更广泛的可信赖性层面和不限成员名额的一代环境。
